topic_ko: 체격 크기와 낙상 부상의 역학 관계
_note: 무관문장(논설문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab의 밑줄 텍스트는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재.

irrelevant.intro: Body size has a significant effect on the severity of injuries sustained in a fall.
sentences: Toddlers tumble frequently, yet the harm they suffer is almost never serious because their bones are proportionally thick relative to their small mass.
Adults, on the other hand, carry greater mass, fall from a higher center of gravity, and react more slowly, all of which combine to produce a far larger impact force.
The nonlinear relationship between mass and bone strength means that adult bones, though thicker in absolute measure, cannot fully offset the extra force generated by greater mass.
Regular walking programs have been shown to improve cardiovascular health and lower blood pressure in middle-aged adults.
By the same logic, taller individuals are more prone to fall-induced fractures such as hip breaks compared to shorter individuals.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: ④ '걷기 운동이 심혈관 건강과 혈압 개선에 효과적'이라는 내용은 낙상 충격과 체격의 역학 관계를 다루는 글 전체 흐름과 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③⑤는 모두 체격(질량·뼈 강도·낙하 높이)과 낙상 부상의 관계라는 주제로 자연스럽게 연결된다.

passage: Physical size directly determines how much damage a person can sustain in an otherwise minor accident.
Young children fall repeatedly without serious injury because their bones are thick relative to their small mass, limiting the energy they build up.
Adults present a very different picture: greater mass, a higher center of gravity, and slower reflexes all contribute to a dramatically larger ground-impact force.
The relationship between mass and bone strength is nonlinear, meaning that bones do not grow stronger at the same rate as body mass increases.
Consequently, an adult's bones, while thicker in absolute terms, may still be insufficient to absorb the shock generated by their heavier mass.
The same physical principles explain why taller people are statistically more likely to fracture a hip or suffer other fall-related injuries than shorter people.
In short, the bigger the body, the more serious the consequences of even a seemingly minor stumble.
Understanding this relationship can help design environments and protective measures that reduce fall injury risks for larger individuals.
choices: the physical principles linking body size to the severity of fall injuries
the best exercise routines for preventing falls in elderly adults
how modern medicine treats fractures caused by falling accidents
the role of nutrition in maintaining strong bones throughout life
why children enjoy falling and tumbling more than adults do
theme.explanation_ko: 체격이 클수록 낙상 시 더 큰 충격을 받으며, 질량과 뼈 강도의 비선형 관계가 그 이유라는 내용. ①이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ②낙상 예방 운동, ③골절 치료법, ④영양과 뼈 건강, ⑤어린이의 낙상 선호는 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: A seemingly harmless stumble can prove far more serious for a large person than for a small child.
Toddlers fall all the time, yet rarely suffer serious injury because their bones are large relative to their mass.
Adults, by contrast, carry more mass, fall from greater heights, and react more slowly — producing a much greater impact.
This disproportionate risk stems from the nonlinear relationship between mass and bone strength.
Even though adult bones are thicker, they are not thick enough relative to the increased impact to offer full protection.
The same logic predicts that taller individuals will suffer more fall-related fractures than shorter ones.
The body's physics, in other words, works against bigger people when gravity wins.
Size brings power, but it also brings a hidden vulnerability every time someone loses their footing.
choices: How to Protect Your Bones as You Age
Why Larger Bodies Are More Vulnerable in a Fall
The Science of Teaching Children to Fall Safely
Mass and Gravity: A Guide to Physical Fitness
Why Taller Athletes Break More Records
title.explanation_ko: 체격이 클수록 낙상 시 부상이 심하고 그 이유가 질량·뼈 강도의 역학이라는 글의 핵심을 압축한 ②가 제목으로 가장 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①노화와 뼈 건강, ③어린이 낙상 안전, ④체력 단련, ⑤운동 기록은 본문 핵심과 다르다.

passage: The bigger someone is, the more damage they can do to themselves through even a relatively innocuous accident.
Despite toddlers falling over and bumping themselves regularly, the injuries they sustain are rarely serious.
Their relatively thick bones in comparison to their mass mean they rarely build up enough energy, even at top speed, to do themselves much damage.

Because of their increased mass (compounded by the fact that they are falling from a greater height and that their reactions may be slower), adults falling over will impact the ground with a much larger force.

The nonlinear relationship between mass and bone strength means that although their bones are thicker than a toddler's in absolute terms, they may not be relatively thick enough compensating for the larger impact caused by their increased mass.
The body mass index (BMI) can serve as a convenient way for non-experts to examine their health conditions in daily lives.
For the same reasons, taller people have been found to suffer more fall-related injuries ― like hip breaks ― than shorter people.

grammar.explanation_ko: ⑤ thick enough 뒤에는 to부정사(to compensate for)가 와야 한다. enough + to V 구문에서 동명사(compensating)는 어법상 틀리다. → to compensate for로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① The 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~ 구문, ② Despite + 동명사(falling) 전치사 뒤 목적어, ③ enough energy ... to do 결과 부정사, ④ compounded by the fact that 삽입 분사구 모두 옳다.

vocab.explanation_ko: ⑤ 글 전체의 논지는 어른의 뼈가 큰 충격을 '상쇄(compensate)'하기에 충분하지 않다는 것이다. worsen(악화시키다)을 쓰면 '충격을 악화시키기에 충분히 두껍지 않다'는 말이 되어 문맥상 어색하다 → compensate로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①innocuous(무해한), ②sustain(입다), ③build up(축적하다), ④compounded(악화된)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

order.explanation_ko: 도입(주어진 글: 덩치 클수록 피해 크고 아기는 덜 다침) → (B) 아기/어른의 뼈·질량 대조와 충격력 비교 → (A) 비선형 관계로 어른의 뼈가 충분하지 않다는 심층 설명 → (C) 결론: 키 큰 사람 낙상 부상 위험. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'adult bones are thicker'는 (B)의 어른 충격력 설명을 전제하므로 (B) 뒤에 와야 하고, (C)의 'For these same reasons'는 (A)까지의 논의를 받으므로 맨 뒤에 온다.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장(비선형 관계로 어른의 뼈가 충격 보상에 부족할 수 있다)은 ④ 앞 '어른이 훨씬 큰 힘으로 충격을 가한다'는 진술을 심층 분석하고, ⑤ '결론: 키 큰 사람 부상 위험'으로 이어진다. ④ 뒤가 가장 적절하다.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장이 없으면 ④의 충격력 진술과 ⑤의 결론 사이에 '왜 뼈가 충분하지 않은가'에 대한 설명이 빠져 논리가 비약한다.

passage: The bigger a person is, the more harm they risk in even a minor accident.
Toddlers fall frequently but rarely get seriously hurt because their bones are proportionally thick for their mass.
Adults, carrying more mass and falling from greater heights with slower reactions, hit the ground with far more force.
The mass-to-bone-strength relationship is nonlinear, so adult bones cannot fully compensate for the increased impact.
This explains why taller people suffer more serious fall-related injuries, such as hip fractures, compared to shorter people.
The body's size, in short, is a key factor in how dangerous a fall can be.
Understanding these physical dynamics may help reduce fall-related injuries in larger individuals.
Prevention strategies should account for the disproportionate risk faced by bigger bodies.
summary.summary_template: Because the relationship between body __(A)__ and bone strength is nonlinear, larger people face a disproportionately greater risk of serious injury in a fall, as their bones cannot fully __(B)__ for the higher impact force generated by their size.
summary.explanation_ko: (A) 질량과 뼈 강도의 비선형 관계이므로 'mass(질량)'. (B) 뼈가 충격을 '상쇄(compensate)'하기에 부족하다는 내용. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 height/fitness/age가 아니라 mass, (B)는 worsen/recover가 아니라 compensate여야 한다. absorb는 의미상 가능하나 본문 표현과 가장 일치하는 것은 compensate이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 누군가가 클수록, 비교적 무해한 사고를 통해서도 그들이 자신에게 입힐 수 있는 피해가 더 커진다.
writing.answer: The bigger someone is, the more damage they can do to themselves through even a relatively innocuous accident.
writing.explanation_ko: 'The 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~'(~할수록 더 …하다) 구문. The bigger someone is, the more damage they can do to themselves.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들의 질량에 비해 상대적으로 두꺼운 뼈는, 자신에게 큰 피해를 줄 만큼의 에너지를 거의 축적하지 않는다는 것을 의미한다.
writing.answer: Their relatively thick bones in comparison to their mass mean they rarely build up enough energy to do themselves much damage.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 Their ... bones → mean + 목적절. enough energy to V(V할 만큼 충분한 에너지).

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 질량과 뼈 강도 사이의 비선형 관계는, 그들의 뼈가 절대적인 면에서는 아기의 것보다 두껍지만 증가된 충격을 보완하기에 충분히 두껍지 않을 수 있다는 것을 의미한다.
conditions: thick enough to compensate 구조를 사용할 것
writing.answer: The nonlinear relationship between mass and bone strength means that although their bones are thicker than a toddler's in absolute terms, they may not be relatively thick enough to compensate for the larger impact caused by their increased mass.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어: The nonlinear relationship ~ / although 양보절: their bones are thicker ... in absolute terms / thick enough to compensate: 충분히 두꺼워 상쇄하다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Because of their increased mass (compounded by the fact that they are falling from a greater height and that their reactions may be slower), adults falling over will impact the ground with a much larger force.
writing.answer: 증가된 질량(더 높은 곳에서 떨어지고 반응이 더 느릴 수 있다는 사실로 인해 가중됨) 때문에, 넘어지는 어른은 훨씬 큰 힘으로 지면에 충격을 가하게 될 것이다.
writing.explanation_ko: compounded by the fact that ~(~라는 사실로 악화된) 삽입구, impact the ground with a larger force(훨씬 큰 힘으로 지면에 충격을 가하다).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Larger individuals are more prone to serious fall injuries because their bones, though thicker in absolute measure, cannot fully (A)___________ for the (B)___________ impact force generated by their greater mass and fall height.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 뼈가 충격을 '상쇄(compensate)'하기에 부족하다 — 본문 compensate for. (B) 증가된 질량으로 인해 충격력이 '더 크다(larger)' — 본문 a much larger force.

writing.context: The nonlinear relationship between mass and bone strength means that although their bones are thicker than a toddler's in absolute terms, they may not be relatively thick enough to ___________ for the larger impact caused by their increased mass.
writing.explanation_ko: thick enough to compensate for ~(~을 상쇄하기에 충분히 두꺼운) 구문. 본문 동사 compensate.
